remarks: Privately situated Top Floor, Corner apartment in desirable Westwood! Make your new home in this sunny, newer, very pretty space featuring an open kitchen with stainless steel appliances, fresh, new neutral carpeting, spacious living/dining area lined with large windows, excellent closet + storage space and your very own in-unit washer/dryer. This economically friendly apartment features central air, gas heat + 5-star energy rated appliances - THERE ARE NO ADDITIONAL FEES! The popular & elegant Westwood community features impeccable maintenance and grounds care with a small fitness center and 24-hour security. Pets are Ok, Dogs  35 Lbs. only, 2-Cats Ok or 1-dog and 1-cat OK (No aggressive breeds and a $300 fully refundable pet deposit required). Westwood is a No Smoking Community. This is a great apartment! Please have interested prospects submit the Westwood application uploaded in supplements with a credit check through Applyconnect only.  This apartment is move-in ready! PLEASE NOTE - THIS IS AN APARTMENT IN A SECURE MID-RISE BUILDING, NOT A STAND ALONE TOWNHOME.
